_about: Public-domain Joseph Wild (1834-1908), Methodist then Congregational minister of Bond Street Church, Toronto, and British-Israel preacher, for the Word Hoard: The Lost Ten Tribes, Seven Sermons, Talks for the Times, How and When the World will End, The Bond Street Pulpit, Canada and the Jesuits, Dr. Wild's Sunday Evening Sermons, and his single sermons and lectures. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 89 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
